Windows x64.

## Changes

- Improved automatic updates with pending-update recovery at startup, installation retries, and diagnostic logging.
- Changed automatic updates to prefer the package with .NET 10 included.
- Fixed duplicate wallpaper cards in browsing results and favorites.
- Improved hover-preview startup timing and playback-loop handling.
- Updated repository documentation for wallpaper sources and features.

## Downloads

- **WITH NET10**: single EXE with .NET 10 included.
- **REQUIRES NET10**: smaller single EXE; requires .NET 10 Desktop Runtime.
